objective1.dial: Morpheus is gone, but Neo's dream isn't. E Pluribus Neo. We will free them all, one by one. Are you with us?

objective2.description: Hack the terminal to open the gate

objective3.dial: I... I had a dream about this. I'm ready to wake up.

objective5.dial: Agents! They are trying to stop the extraction!

objective7.dial: We saved another one. The movement is growing.
